compose:
services:

    image: x
    labels:
      traefik.http.routers.mesh.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_MESH:-mesh.portcullis.local}`)
      traefik.http.routers.mesh.middlewares: portcullis-auth@docker,portcullis-groups@docker
    networks: [default, portcullis-proxy]
  meshadmin:
    image: x
    labels:
      traefik.http.routers.meshadmin.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_MESHADMIN:-mesh-admin.portcullis.local}`)

  init:

networks:
  portcullis-proxy:
    external: true

description: A mesh VPN control server
icon: "\U0001F310"
category: vpn
tags: [vpn]
links:
  website: https://example.org/
  source: https://example.org/src
instances: multi
ai: {unsupported: "test fixture"}
auth:
  method: forward-auth
  group_access: true
  access_group: users_mesh
  admin_group: admin_mesh
jobs: [init]
hooks:
  - {name: vpn-devices, service: glue, command: [glue, devices], when: [vpn]}
  - {name: vpn-dns, service: glue, command: [glue, dns], when: [vpn]}
vpn:
  label: Mesh tailnet
  ranges: ["100.64.0.0/10"]
  ingress: {service: gateway, proxy_protocol: v2}
  identity: {source: hook, hook: vpn-devices, owner: oidc_sub, refresh: 60s}
  dns: {hook: vpn-dns}
  control_routers: [mesh]
compose:
services:
  mesh:
    image: x
    labels:
      traefik.http.routers.mesh.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_MESH:-mesh.portcullis.local}`)
      traefik.http.routers.mesh.middlewares: portcullis-auth@docker,portcullis-groups@docker
    networks: [default, portcullis-proxy]
  meshadmin:
    image: x
    labels:
      traefik.http.routers.meshadmin.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_MESHADMIN:-mesh-admin.portcullis.local}`)
      traefik.http.routers.meshadmin.middlewares: portcullis-auth@docker,portcullis-groups@docker
    networks: [default, portcullis-proxy]
  gateway:
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    image: ghcr.io/porelli/portcullis-forwarder:1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exec fwd --to $$PORTCULLIS_VPN_EDGE"]
  fwd:
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    image: ghcr.io/porelli/portcullis-forwarder:1@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
    network_mode: service:gateway
  spy:
    image: x
    ipc: service:fwd
  glue:
    image: x
  init:
    image: x
    restart: "no"
networks:
  portcullis-proxy:
    external: true
want_error: vpn.ingress.service: spy shares the ipc namespace of fwd

  - {name: vpn-devices, service: glue, command: [glue, devices], when: [vpn]}
  - {name: vpn-dns, service: glue, command: [glue, dns], when: [vpn]}
vpn:
  label: Mesh tailnet
  ranges: ["100.64.0.0/10"]
  ingress: {service: gateway, proxy_protocol: v2}
  identity: {source: hook, hook: vpn-devices, owner: oidc_sub, refresh: 60s}
  dns: {hook: vpn-dns}
  control_routers: [mesh]
compose:
services:
  mesh:
    image: x
    labels:
      traefik.http.routers.mesh.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_MESH:-mesh.portcullis.local}`)
      traefik.http.routers.mesh.middlewares: portcullis-auth@docker,portcullis-groups@docker
    networks: [default, portcullis-proxy]
  meshadmin:
    image: x
    labels:
      traefik.http.routers.meshadmin.rule: Host(`${PORTCULLIS_HOST_MESHADMIN:-mesh-admin.portcullis.local}`)
      traefik.http.routers.meshadmin.middlewares: portcullis-auth@docker,portcullis-groups@docker
    networks: [default, portcullis-proxy]
  gateway:
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    image: ghcr.io/porelli/portcullis-forwarder:1
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exec fwd --to $$PORTCULLIS_VPN_EDGE"]
  glue:
    image: x
    volumes: ["C:/data:/d"]
  init:
    image: x
    restart: "no"
networks:
  portcullis-proxy:
    external: true
volumes:
  C: {}
want_error: vpn: volume C: a VPN template's volume names are longer than one letter
